title.narrative: Studie av svenskt bidrag till enegisektorn över 60 år
Study of Swedish contribution to the energy sector over 60 years

description.narrative: In 2023, Swedish development cooperation in Tanzania is celebrating 60 years. Over the years a prioritized sector for the Swedish - Tanzanian partnership has been the energy sector. Sweden has invested heavily in the energy sector in mainland Tanzania and on Zanzibar for close to six decades. These investments have included installation of power generating equipment and powerlines, feasibility studies, capacity building as well as institutional and policy development support. Sweden is recognised as one of the main development partners in energy in Tanzania. The Embassy of Sweden in Tanzania would now like to take stock of these investments over the last six decades have meant for general development in the country.

Under 2023 firar ambassaden i Tanzania 60 år. Eneregisektorn har varit en prioriterad sektor för det svensk-tanzaniska partnerskapet under åren. Sverige har investerat stort i energisektorn på fastlandet och på Zanzibar. Dessa investeringar har inkluderat installation för generering av elektricitet och elnät, förstudier, kapacitetsbyggande samt policyarbete. Sverige är en av de främsta givarna i energisektorn i Tanzania. Ambassaden vill nu dra lärdom från vad sex decennier av investeringar i energisektorn har haft för betydelse för landets utveckling i stort.
